assessment.question:
### Exercise 1.4: Do addition with numbers that have the digit 9

3. Add 10 to the number 7,992.
assessment.expected_answer:
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{hth} & \text{tth} & \text{th} & \text{h} & \text{  t  } & \text{  u  }  \\
 (100,000) & (10,000) & (1,000) & (100) & (10) & (1) \\
\hline
   &  & 7 & 9 & 9 & 2  \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

The "**t**" column becomes 0 and the "**h**" column increases by 1. Note that there is a 9 in the **h** column too. When 1 is added to 9, it becomes 0, and the column to its left increases by 1.

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{hth} & \text{tth} & \text{th} & \text{h} & \text{  t  } & \text{  u  }  \\
 (100,000) & (10,000) & (1,000) & (100) & (10) & (1) \\
\hline
   &  & 8 & 0 & 0 & 2  \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

$$
7,992+10=8,002
$$

assessment.question:
### Exercise 5.2: Add and subtract whole numbers

3. Determine the difference in the two place values of 5 in the following numbers.

To determine the difference between two numbers, subtract the smaller number from the larger number.

1. 1,025,568
2. 58,753
3. 5,198,352
assessment.expected_answer:
1. 1,025,568
The place values are 5,000 and 500.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4 \phantom{00} _{10}\phantom{00}\\
& \cancel{5},\cancel{0}00 \\
- & 5\;00 \\
\hline
& 4\,,\;5\;00\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

2. 58,753
The place values are 50,000 and 50.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4\;\;\,_9\;\;\;\, _{10}\phantom{0}\\
& \cancel{5}\cancel{0},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}0 \\
- & 5\;0 \\
\hline
& 4\;\;9\,,\;9\;5\;0\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

3. 5,198,352
The place values are 5,000,000 and 50.
$$
\begin{array}{r r}
&_4\;\;\;_9\;\;\,_9\;\; _9\;\;\;\; _9\;\; _{10}\phantom{0}\\
& \cancel{5},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}\cancel{0},\cancel{0}\cancel{0}0 \\
- & 5\;0 \\
\hline
& 4,\;\;9\;\;9\;\;9\;,\;9\;\,5\;0\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
